symptom: The Shadow Evidence Draft 2020-12 source.journalMode rule used minLength:1 only. A schema-only consumer admitted whitespace-only strings (including U+FEFF) although the runtime validator rejects them using ECMAScript trim. Python and ECMAScript also disagree on U+0085 for generic nonblank regexes. Synthetic schema-only probes demonstrated the discrepancy; no production incident or private evidence was observed.
lesson: JSON Schema minLength:1 does not enforce runtime trim-based nonblank admission. The portable explicit ECMAScript whitespace complement pattern must also cover metadata fields such as source.journalMode; generic \S differs across JSON Schema engines for U+FEFF and U+0085.
guardrail: Require the exact ECMAScript trim whitespace-complement pattern on source.journalMode while retaining minLength:1. Verify whitespace-only rejection, U+FEFF rejection, U+0085 acceptance, and valid journal modes against the runtime validator. This metadata check never authenticates an issuer, settlement, finality, evaluation readiness or production authority.
